description: This file implements semantic versioning (semver) parsing, comparison, and manipulation in Go. It defines a Version struct, parsing functions, comparison methods, and utility functions for handling semantic version strings.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Represents a semantic version with major, minor, patch, pre-release, and metadata components.

classes.name: PreRelease
classes.description: Type alias for string, representing the pre-release part of a version.

methods.name: splitOff
methods.description: Splits the input string at the first occurrence of the delimiter, updating the input and returning the split part.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Parses and sets the version components from a version string.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the version.

methods.name: UnmarshalYAML
methods.description: Unmarshals a YAML string into the Version object.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes the Version to JSON format.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into the Version object.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares this version with another, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks if this version is equal to another.

methods.name: LessThan
methods.description: Checks if this version is less than another.

methods.name: Slice
methods.description: Returns a slice of the major, minor, and patch components.

methods.name: PreRelease.Slice
methods.description: Splits the pre-release string into parts.

methods.name: preReleaseCompare
methods.description: Compares two versions' pre-release parts according to semver rules.

methods.name: recursiveCompare
methods.description: Recursively compares two slices of version components.

methods.name: BumpMajor
methods.description: Increments the major version, resets minor, patch, pre-release, and metadata.

methods.name: BumpMinor
methods.description: Increments the minor version, resets patch, pre-release, and metadata.

methods.name: BumpPatch
methods.description: Increments the patch version, resets pre-release and metadata.

methods.name: validateIdentifier
methods.description: Validates that an identifier conforms to semver rules.
